newsitem.title: UK: Palm oil holds firmer in Europe, trade turns flat.
newsitem.headline: Palm oil holds firmer in Europe, trade turns flat.

text.p: The European palm oil sector held steady in the afternoon to close slightly firmer, although just of its highs, but business turned virtually flat, traders said.

Earlier gains were reported on the palm oils on the back of expectations that June 1-25 Malaysian palm oil export data due for release later this week by cargo surveyor SGS (M) Sdn Bhd would be supportive.
During the afternoon session just the one trade was reported, this was for Sep olein at $552.50 per tonne.
The soft oils ended unchanged to one guilder up, following similar gains overseas overnight.
Light short-coveringwas sparked by the move higher, but was tempered by uncertainty following a mixed start to trading on the Chicago soybean oil futures.
Soy oil traded Nov/Jan at 102.25 guilders per 100 kilos, while rape oil fetched 103 guilders per 100 kilos for Aug/Oct and 103.50 for Nov/Jan.
Nov/Jan soy oil also traded at 102 guilders in a switch with the same position on rape oil at 103 guilders.
Palmkernel oil unchanged from its midday levels of $5 to $10 firmer, with one trade on Aug/Sep at $637.50. Coconut oil on the other hand, closed unchanged and completely tradeless.
